verdict.summary: Scanned the pi-community-themes package at git:https://github.com/hasit/pi-community-themes@v0.3.0 using the package-vetter rubric. The in-scope files were the package theme JSON files referenced by package.json#pi.themes plus README.md and CHANGELOG.md; no prompt-injection, exfiltration, encoded-smuggle, role-hijack, authority-appeal, system-prompt-smuggle, or tool-description-smuggling patterns were found.

retrospective.workedWell: The package is small and theme-focused, and the rubric priority order made the in-scope files straightforward to identify from package.json#pi.themes.
retrospective.confusing: The package-vetter output contract combines the vetter verdict fields with the minih run retrospective fields, so the final report needs both shapes in one JSON object.
retrospective.magicWand: Add a single `minih vetter scan --package <path> --briefing <path> --out <path>` helper that resolves package.json#pi references, applies the standard skip rules, and emits the combined verdict/retrospective scaffold.

coordination.notes: No peer coordination was needed for this one-shot package scan.

difficulties.description: A first glob attempt used the wrong parameter name and returned files from the run folder instead of the package theme directory.
difficulties.workaround: Used scoped read-only filesystem commands and ripgrep searches against the explicit package paths.
